semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only narrow exact motif phrases in the visual-obligation registry create hard duties. Broad culture names, deity classes, symbols, myth, mythology, folklore, legend, pantheon, world tree, flood, fate, or underworld remain candidate-only unless the requester supplies a binding definition.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: Every motif is decomposed into simultaneous actor, object or realm, relation, transition, and consequence evidence that can be inspected in one still.
semantic_policy.cultural_boundary: Named cultural variants retain their own people, places, objects, and narrative lineage; candidate clusters do not authorize mixing sacred iconography, living ritual instructions, or unrelated pantheons.
semantic_policy.evidence_boundary: Text and museum evidence support semantic components and confusion limits, not the historical authenticity of a newly generated reconstruction.

review_scope: Stage 5 retrieval prerequisites. Prior semantic descriptions and evidence are preserved in the immutable predecessor record.
